description: This file defines an abstract base class 'PriorityPreset' for notification priority presets within an Android wearable notifications system. It provides a constructor and an abstract method to apply the preset to a notification builder and wearable options.

classes.name: PriorityPreset
classes.description: Abstract base class for notification priority presets, extending 'NamedPreset'. It includes a constructor and an abstract 'apply' method to set notification priorities.

methods.name: PriorityPreset
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the preset with a resource ID for the name.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Abstract method intended to set the notification priority on a NotificationCompat.Builder and wearable options extender.
